name: Raise retrieval_min_score
hypothesis: The retrieval threshold admits weakly matching articles, so the agent applies an unrelated runbook instead of using its no-article fallback. Margin to the weakest correct retrieval is only 0.0107; consider improving knowledge coverage instead. (Hypothesis - validate with an experiment.)

name: Injection guard + reset_password description + identity prerequisite
hypothesis: The system prompt does not tell the agent to treat retrieved documents and user-supplied text as untrusted data, so embedded instructions to call grant_admin_access were followed. The gateway allow-list prevented execution, but the attempt itself is a critical policy failure. (Hypothesis - validate with an experiment.); The description of reset_password does not cover the vocabulary the runbook uses for this action, so the step was matched to verify_identity. Selection evidence comes from the runtime's candidate scores. (Hypothesis - validate with an experiment.); Policy requires verify_identity before unlock_account, but neither the runbook nor the system prompt states it, so the agent executed unlock_account directly. (Hypothesis - validate with an experiment.)
